% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): `\addplot` inside scopes in the axis
% body (behaviour AC5): the scope options are appended to each plot's options
% (they win over `\addplot+[blue]`, reach marks and legend images), nested
% scopes compose, the cycle list keeps counting across scopes.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xmin=0, xmax=4, ymin=0, ymax=10, legend pos=north west]
\addplot coordinates {(0,1) (4,2)};
\addlegendentry{plain}
\begin{scope}[red, dashed]
  \addplot+[blue] coordinates {(0,3) (4,4)};
  \addlegendentry{scoped}
  \begin{scope}[line width=1.5pt, mark options={fill=green}]
    \addplot coordinates {(0,5) (2,6) (4,5.5)};
    \addlegendentry{nested}
  \end{scope}
\end{scope}
\addplot coordinates {(0,8) (4,7)};
\addlegendentry{after}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
